lane:
محث

محث_شيئا مَحَثَ شَيْئًا 1 _i. q._ حَثَمَهُ. (L.)

مَحْثٌ _One who mixes with people, and eats and converses with them._ (MF, from the Námoos of [the Mulla 'Alee] El-Káree: [but SM expresses some doubt of its correctness, or whether it be correctly مخث].
